title: Module 4: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)
description: Welcome to Module 4 of the Physical AI and Humanoid Robotics Course. This module covers the complete Vision-Language-Action pipeline, integrating speech processing, natural language understanding, and robot action execution to enable humanoid robots to understand natural language commands and execute multi-step physical tasks.
